spans.s: (etym. doubtful; √ उष्, Uṇ. ii, 4) the lip (generally du.), RV. ii, 39, 6; AV. x, 9, 14; xx, 127, 4; VS.; ŚBr.; Mn. &c.
the forepart of an Agnikuṇḍa q.v., Hcat.

etym.s: [cf. Zd. aoshtra; O. Pruss. austa, ‘mouth’; O. Slav. usta, ‘mouth’.]

spans.s: the plant Coccinia Grandis (to whose red fruits lips are commonly compared), L.
(in a compound the ओ of ओष्ठ forms with a preceding अ either Vṛddhi औ, or Guṇa ओ, Kāty. on Pāṇ. vi, 1, 94) ;
ओष्ठ—कर्णक m. pl. N. of a people, VP.; R.
ओष्ठ—कोप m. disease of the lips, Suśr.
ओष्ठ—ज mfn. produced by the lips, labial.
ओष्ठ—जाह n. the root of the lips (?), Pāṇ. v, 2, 24.
ओष्ठ—पल्लव n. ‘lip-bud’, a lip.
ओष्ठ—पुट m. the space between the lips, MBh.; Śak. &c.
ओष्ठ—प्रकोप m. = -कोप above.
ओष्ठ—फला f. bearing lip-like fruits, the plant Coccinia Grandis, Nigh.
ओष्ठ—मुद्रा f. sealed i.e. closed lips, Uttarar.
ओष्ठ—रुचक (Hariv.), -रुचिर (Viṣṇ.), n. lovely lips
ओष्ठ—रोग m. = -कोप above.
ओष्ठ—शतक n. N. of a poem.
du. the upper and lower lip.
covered by the lips, MantraBr.; AitĀr.
= ओष्ठ-फला above, L.
ifc. = ओ॑ष्ठ, lip
taking care of the lips, Pāṇ. v, 2, 66.
being at the lips, belonging to the lips, Suśr. &c.
esp. produced by the lips, labial (as certain sounds), RPrāt.; APrāt. Comm. on Pāṇ. &c.
a labial sound, PārGṛ. iii, 16.
ओष्ठ्य—योनि mfn. produced from labial sounds.
ओष्ठ्य—स्थान mfn. pronounced with the lips.
